svg.title: How dscc-morpheus-plugin works
svg.desc: Architecture and flows of dscc-morpheus-plugin: the browser, the plugin inside the Morpheus appliance, and HPE GreenLake Data Services.
svg.text: The HPE array, volume and LUN under every HPE Morpheus datastore, host and VM, with health and capacity from HPE GreenLake Data Services. Read-only.
